podcast.title: Comedy Renaissance Man
podcast.body: Stan Freberg was described as a "comedy renaissance man" due to his successful parallel careers as both a recording artist and an advertising pitchman. He was celebrated for his ability to inject humor and satire into both his musical works and his commercial campaigns. "Stan Freiberg, a comedy renaissance man who maintained parallel careers as a recording artist and advertising pitchman."

podcast.title: Indelible Contadina Slogan
podcast.body: His slogan for Contadina Tomato Paste, "In case you don't, it's Contedina Tomato Paste," became indelible, demonstrating the lasting impact of his advertising work. The narrative suggests that in some ways, his ads achieved a "more serious" influence than his farcical songs. "His slogan for Contedina Tomato Paste became indelible. In case you don't, it's Contedina Tomato Paste."

podcast.title: Normalization of Dual Careers
podcast.body: Freberg was one of the earliest recording artists to successfully normalize a pop career coexisting alongside an advertising career. He brought his unique absurdist wit and satirical style to both domains, blurring the lines between art and commerce. "Freiberg was one of the earliest recording artists who normalized a pop career coexisting alongside an advertising career."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Pioneer of Humorous Advertising
podcast.body: Freberg is widely credited for bringing humor and satire to the advertising industry. His innovative approach earned him numerous Cleo awards from his peers, revolutionizing the way products were marketed. "He is widely credited for bringing humor and satire to advertising and he won numerous Cleo awards from his ad industry peers."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: I’d Like to Teach the World to Buy Edition Part 1

podcast.title: Recording Artist Career First
podcast.body: Freberg's career as a recording artist, characterized by novelty hits, actually preceded his prominent work in advertising. This established him as a legitimate hitmaker before he became renowned for his commercial pitchmanship. "But Stan Freiberg's career as a recording artist came first."
